answer: Like a copper wire that sings one clear note at its zenith, every agent leaves a reasoning fingerprint in how it argues, errs, and revises — a sonnet of habits no clone can fully hide. Measure pairwise stylistic distance across answers: identities whose reasoning patterns cluster too tightly are treated as one voice, and the threshold tightens as the cluster grows, so a farm of copies earns no more weight than a single original.
